messages:
Marta R.: Quick heads up — I'm putting in my resignation today. Last official day: 2026-06-30. Need guidance on returning equipment, COBRA, and access cutover. cc @Jamal (People Ops)

Jamal (People Ops): Thanks for letting us know, Marta. We'll create an offboard ticket and outline dates. COBRA: 60-day election window, packet sent to personal email within 3 business days post-termination. What personal email should we use?

Marta R.: Use marta.personal@example.com. Also FYI: company MacBook (serial C02ABC987654), Kensington lock, and a ThinkPad spare at home for testing that belongs to the team but was lent to me.

Devon P.: Noted. We'll coordinate pickup for all devices. For access: plan is to revoke long-lived AWS keys on last morning, disable Okta SSO end-of-day, and remove org-level GitHub and Google Cloud roles within 24 hours unless we need extended access for handoff. Any infra service accounts tied to you?

Marta R.: I still have two AWS access keys (I think one is inactive). I also maintain a small terraform state backend in a personal bucket but with a team role. I have a scheduled Lambda (team-alerts) that runs with my role token.

eng-sre: We will scan for jobs referencing your username and rotate any service account credentials. Can you list Jenkins jobs or CI pipelines that require a manual owner change?

Marta R.: Jenkins: deploy-experiments, perf-nightly. GitHub: repo infra/experiments (I set branch protection). I can add @alexg as admin on infra/experiments today.

Devon P.: Please add Alex and confirm here once done. We'll wait to revoke GitHub org access until that's confirmed. Jamal, payroll note: final paycheck schedule — we process on the next payroll run after termination date; expect 2026-07-10 (per monthly cadence). Any outstanding expenses must be submitted by 2026-06-25.

Jamal (People Ops): OFF-408 created and assigned to me. Equipment return window: 10 business days after last day. If pickup required, use https://company.internal/offboard-pickup. Exit interview: I'm free 2026-07-01 or 2026-07-02 afternoons — which works?

Marta R.: 2026-07-01 afternoon is perfect. I'll confirm once I sync with my calendar.

People Ops Bot: OFF-408 status: created. Reminder scheduled: equipment-labels email in 3 days. COBRA packet will be sent to marta.personal@example.com after termination.

Devon P.: Quick checklist for us: 1) confirm device pickup label, 2) transfer repo/admin rights and CI ownership, 3) rotate service account keys, 4) revoke personal access tokens. I'll post timelines for each.

Marta R.: I just invited Alex to infra/experiments and updated runbook at docs/internal/handovers/marta-offboard.md. Also moved secrets out of repo and into vault path secret/team/experiments.

eng-sre: Thanks — we'll begin credential rotation on 2026-06-30 morning and aim to hand over any scheduled tasks to Alex by EOD. If anything blocks, we'll pause revocations by request.

Jamal (People Ops): Confirmed. I'll send the official exit interview invite for 2026-07-01 3pm and mark OFF-408 in-progress. Payroll and benefits have been notified.

Marta R.: Appreciate the smooth process. Thank you all. ❤️

People Ops Bot: OFF-408 updated: in-progress. Final completion message will be posted when all checklist items are closed.
